compatibility.rationale: Octet production proof rails use this exact reviewed verifier release.
Trellis retains its independently reviewed verifier and proof receipts until an explicit upgrade rerun succeeds.
OnixOS lifecycle proof execution consumes the exact Octet profile, verifier, and formatter packages; OnixOS retains source-model and receipt authority.
Aspen's compatibility probe consumes the exact Octet profile and verifier package without authorizing runtime adoption or transferring upstream proof claims.
VerusBelt models a recorded snapshot and does not establish soundness for the Octet verifier release.
The selected verusfmt release does not publish an aarch64-linux binary asset; source packaging remains future work.

non_claims: A compatibility row records reviewed identity relationships and does not transfer proof validity, verifier soundness, solver soundness, semantic coverage, or receipt authority across versions.
Nix SHA-256 values satisfy fixed-output fetch requirements; Octet uses BLAKE3 for stack-owned binary, closure, artifact, and receipt identities after materialization.
Formatter success proves only selected source formatting and does not prove Verus success, Rust correctness, whole-program safety, or release eligibility.
